title: Looker Studio Failures by Report
app: Looker Studio usage and error telemetry via the Google Cloud logging export to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=lookerstudio:usage event="data_source_error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by report_id
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Looker Studio failures grouped by report so operators immediately see which specific reports are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Looker Studio is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Looker Studio failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical reports.
visualization: Table of report by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Looker Studio are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
